synopsis: The booklet identifies OPAL-RT as a provider of real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) benches, with 4DV-SIM and OP5707XG2 included among data-replay and HIL offerings [f16101, f8364]. Chapter 11 positions 4DV-SIM and OPAL-RT's real-time HIL offerings for off-highway and autonomous vehicles, and cites named off-highway and defense users as off-road evidence [f8648, f8808, f8809]. OP5707XG2 is identified as a CPU/FPGA real-time system, consistent with the glossary's classification of OPAL-RT CPU and FPGA systems as real-time computing hardware [f8650, f16180]. Pricing for 4DV-SIM and OP5707XG2 is quote only, leaving planners without a stated purchase price in these facts [f8651].
